::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 20th 1894  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 210-11
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_942.qmd)
I shall be very glad that [the Rubies of St Lo](cmy_books/cmybook_234.qmd) should be published as you propose, I receiving [/4 per copy](organizations/other_160.qmd) sold. Thanks for the two school Lances of Lynwood.[^1] I am only just come home from Devon or I should have written sooner

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: *The Lances of Lynwood* had just been brought out in an abridged edition for schools (London: Macmillan 1894)
